subject: Startups
title: Values Drift
description: A micro-lesson that makes Values Drift usable.

hook.text: Uber's original culture valued 'always be hustling.

buildup.text: Values drift happens when a company's environment changes but its values don't evolve.

discovery.text: Uber brought in Dara Khosrowshahi specifically to reset the culture.

twist.text: Changing values isn't enough—you must change incentives. People follow rewards, not posters.

climax.text: Revisiting values annually keeps them relevant. A value that helped at 10 people might hurt at 10,000.

punchline.text: Values that don't evolve become liabilities.

quiz.question: Who was brought in to reset Uber's culture?
